title: Mancala
description: *Mancala* is a **two-game board game for the browser**: Kalah, the version most people know, and **Ba-awa**, the game played in Ghana, where one move crosses the board many times and the winner takes pits off the loser between rounds.
I set the rules from how Ba-awa is really played, and the bar for the feel: every seed is animated into the pit it lands in.
It ships **six AI opponents**, ranked by a **round-robin tournament the project runs itself**, from random play to a timed **minimax search**.
